rows.target_column_description: Unique identifier for the loan agreement
rows.business_logic:
MERGE branch [NOT MATCHED → INSERT]: src.agreement_id
MERGE branch [MATCHED → UPDATE]: No change (key column; used in ON condition: tgt.loan_agreement_id = src.agreement_id AND tgt.active = '1')
rows.target_table_description: Foundation Data Product - loan agreement entity-state table. SCD2 history via MERGE: MATCHED records are end-dated when source values change; NOT MATCHED records are inserted as new active rows. Grain: loan_agreement_id per effective period.

rows.business_logic:
MERGE branch [NOT MATCHED → INSERT]: CAST(src.loan_amt AS DECIMAL(18,2))
MERGE branch [MATCHED → UPDATE]: Column participates in change detection (tgt.loan_amount <> src.loan_amount); old record end-dated, no value update on existing row

MERGE branch [NOT MATCHED → INSERT]: CASE WHEN src.rate_type_cd = 'F' THEN 'FIXED' WHEN src.rate_type_cd = 'V' THEN 'VARIABLE' WHEN src.rate_type_cd = 'T' THEN 'TRACKER' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END
MERGE branch [MATCHED → UPDATE]: Column participates in change detection (tgt.interest_rate_type <> src.interest_rate_type); old record end-dated, no value update on existing row

MERGE branch [NOT MATCHED → INSERT]: CAST(TO_DATE(CAST(src.row_last_modified_dt AS STRING), 'yyyyMMdd') AS DATE)
MERGE branch [MATCHED → UPDATE]: Not updated on existing row (old record retains original eff_start_date)

rows.target_column_description: SCD2 effective end date (3499-12-31 for current)
rows.business_logic:
MERGE branch [NOT MATCHED → INSERT]: CAST('3499-12-31' AS DATE) -- high-end date sentinel for new active record
MERGE branch [MATCHED → UPDATE]: SET tgt.eff_end_date = src.eff_start_date -- close old record with new record's effective start date

MERGE branch [NOT MATCHED → INSERT]: '1' -- new record is always active
MERGE branch [MATCHED → UPDATE]: SET tgt.active = '0' -- close previous active record

MERGE branch [NOT MATCHED → INSERT]: current_timestamp()
MERGE branch [MATCHED → UPDATE]: Not updated (retains original load timestamp)

MERGE branch [NOT MATCHED → INSERT]: current_timestamp()
MERGE branch [MATCHED → UPDATE]: current_timestamp() -- updated when old record is end-dated; excluded from CDC hash
